name: several-criteria
title: Units measured on several criteria
idea: Units can be ordered differently on different criteria, and each criterion has its own pair probabilities.
from: new concept · v1 storyboard P-01; postrank vignette m2; picture: the thirty sites on three criteria and the six sites on two scores, with each criterion's posterior intervals, its own order and the pairs whose criteria point opposite ways
credit: After the postrank vignette m2 and the theory book, ch. 12.
caption: Synthetic postrank Normal laws: thirty sites on three criteria or six sites on two scores. Marginal posterior intervals and mean orders, not optimized grades.
